mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) reduce the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate is below 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 245 signals heightened inflation risk, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 245), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise >0.2% and CPIAUCSL rise >0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 units signal economic weakness, prompting potential central bank rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1300), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals economic contraction, prompting potential central bank stimulus and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS rise >0.5% and UNRATE fall >0.2%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand expansion regime (HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 460000), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days, as strong consumer and housing demand support economic growth and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 460000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
